title: HaBye
description: The last message before the phone forgets its pairing, or pauses: HA shows idle, and raises a repair for every reason but `paused`. Sign-out and account deletion send it as one attempt (README «The outbox and the store»); HA's silence repair is the backstop. `account_ref`, `revision` (the live sequence) and `phone_now` are the native poster's stamps; a `bye` from `forget` is stamped and sealed in the same critical section that deletes the pairing.

reason.description: disconnected: the person disconnected in RAW; signed_out; account_deleted; paused: «Send to Home Assistant» off, the pairing kept.

account_ref.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the RAW account id keyed by HA's instance id (the custom webhook's: keyed by its URL), lowercase hex.
